title.en: A targeted plan to raise your IELTS by 0.5–1.0 band
title.uz: IELTS ballini 0,5–1,0 ga oshirish uchun aniq reja

what.en: Most applications are blocked by English before anything else. Aim at your weakest skill, not at “more practice”.
what.uz: Ko‘p arizalar avvalo ingliz tili tufayli to‘xtaydi. “Ko‘proq mashq” emas, eng zaif ko‘nikmangizni nishonga oling.

steps.en: Take one full timed mock test and record each skill’s band
steps.uz: Bitta to‘liq vaqtli mock test topshiring va har ko‘nikma balini yozib qo‘ying

steps.en: Pick the weakest skill and study its marking criteria
steps.uz: Eng zaif ko‘nikmani tanlab, uning baholash mezonlarini o‘rganing

steps.en: Do 3 timed tasks a week in that skill and get them marked
steps.uz: Shu ko‘nikmadan haftasiga 3 ta vaqtli topshiriq bajaring va tekshirtiring

steps.en: Retake a full mock every 4 weeks; book the real test when two mocks hit the target
steps.uz: Har 4 haftada to‘liq mock topshiring; ikki mock maqsadga yetganda haqiqiy testga yoziling

cv.en: IELTS Academic [overall] (L [x], R [x], W [x], S [x]), [month year]
cv.uz: IELTS Academic [umumiy] (L [x], R [x], W [x], S [x]), [oy yil]

angle.en: Usually not an essay topic — let the score speak.
angle.uz: Odatda insho mavzusi emas — ball o‘zi gapiradi.

pitfall.en: Booking the real test before mocks reach the target wastes money and time. (Preparation can be free; the official test itself has a fee.)
pitfall.uz: Mocklar maqsadga yetmasdan haqiqiy testga yozilish pul va vaqtni behuda sarflaydi. (Tayyorgarlik bepul bo‘lishi mumkin; rasmiy testning o‘zi pullik.)

evidence.en: Mock results by date, the official Test Report Form.
evidence.uz: Sanalar bo‘yicha mock natijalari, rasmiy Test Report Form.

ladder.en: Meets the minimum of your targets
Meets the higher minimums (e.g. 6.5–7.0) with no band below 6.0
ladder.uz: Yuqoriroq minimumlarga (masalan, 6.5–7.0) yetadi, hech bir bo‘lim 6.0 dan past emas

ladder.en: 7.5+ with balanced sub-scores — removes English as a question entirely
ladder.uz: 7.5+ va muvozanatli bo‘limlar — ingliz tili savoli umuman yo‘qoladi

title.en: Raise the grades that matter for your subject
title.uz: Yo‘nalishingiz uchun muhim fanlardan baholarni oshiring

what.en: Readers look first at the subjects closest to your degree (maths for engineering and economics, biology/chemistry for medicine).
what.uz: O‘quvchi avvalo darajangizga eng yaqin fanlarga qaraydi (muhandislik va iqtisod uchun matematika, tibbiyot uchun biologiya/kimyo).

steps.en: List the 3–4 subjects closest to your intended degree and your current marks
steps.uz: Yo‘nalishingizga eng yaqin 3–4 fan va hozirgi baholaringizni yozing

steps.en: Ask each teacher what exactly would move your mark up
steps.uz: Har bir ustozdan bahoni aynan nima ko‘tarishini so‘rang

steps.en: Set a weekly routine for the weakest one and track test results
steps.uz: Eng zaif fan uchun haftalik tartib tuzing va test natijalarini kuzating

steps.en: If a final exam is coming, plan revision backwards from its date
steps.uz: Yakuniy imtihon yaqin bo‘lsa, takrorlashni uning sanasidan orqaga rejalang

cv.en: [Subject]: improved from [x] to [y] ([term/year])
cv.uz: [Fan]: [x] dan [y] gacha oshirildi ([chorak/yil])

angle.en: An upward trend can be mentioned briefly if it shows how you work — do not make it the whole story.
angle.uz: O‘sish tendensiyasi qanday ishlashingizni ko‘rsatsa, qisqa eslatish mumkin — butun hikoyani unga qurmang.

pitfall.en: Spreading effort evenly over all subjects instead of the ones the programme cares about.
pitfall.uz: Kuchni dastur qiziqadigan fanlarga emas, hamma fanga teng taqsimlash.

evidence.en: Transcripts by term, teacher comments.

ladder.en: No core subject below the programme’s typical level
ladder.uz: Asosiy fanlarning birortasi dasturning odatiy darajasidan past emas

ladder.en: Core subjects among your best marks
ladder.uz: Asosiy fanlar eng yaxshi baholaringiz qatorida

ladder.en: Top marks in core subjects plus an extra (olympiad round, advanced course)
ladder.uz: Asosiy fanlarda eng yuqori baholar va qo‘shimcha natija (olimpiada bosqichi, chuqurlashtirilgan kurs)

title.en: Build relationships with two future recommenders
title.uz: Ikki bo‘lajak tavsiya beruvchi bilan munosabat quring

what.en: Strong letters need specific examples. A teacher can only write them if they have seen your work up close.
what.uz: Kuchli tavsiyanoma aniq misollarni talab qiladi. Ustoz ishingizni yaqindan ko‘rgan bo‘lsagina ularni yoza oladi.

steps.en: Choose two teachers/lecturers in subjects close to your degree
steps.uz: Yo‘nalishingizga yaqin fanlardan ikki ustoz/o‘qituvchini tanlang

steps.en: Ask one good question per week after class or in office hours
steps.uz: Har hafta darsdan keyin bitta yaxshi savol bering

steps.en: Do one extra piece of work with each (a presentation, a small project)
steps.uz: Har biri bilan bitta qo‘shimcha ish bajaring (taqdimot, kichik loyiha)

steps.en: Two months before deadlines, give each a one-page summary of what you did and where you apply
steps.uz: Muddatdan ikki oy oldin har biriga nima qilganingiz va qayerga topshirayotganingiz haqida bir betlik xulosa bering

cv.en: — (shows up in the letters, not the CV)
cv.uz: — (tavsiyanomalarda ko‘rinadi, CV’da emas)

angle.en: Your recommenders can mention the specific project — keep your letter and theirs consistent.
angle.uz: Tavsiya beruvchilar aynan shu loyihani eslatishi mumkin — xatingiz va ularniki mos bo‘lsin.

pitfall.en: Asking a famous person who barely knows you: a generic letter from a big name is weaker than a specific letter from your teacher.
pitfall.uz: Sizni deyarli tanimaydigan mashhur odamdan so‘rash: katta nomdan umumiy xat, ustozingizdan aniq xatdan zaifroq.

evidence.en: The one-page brief you give them, emails confirming they will write.
evidence.uz: Ularga beradigan bir betlik xulosa, yozishga roziligini tasdiqlovchi xatlar.

ladder.en: Two teachers who know your name and grades
ladder.uz: Ismingiz va baholaringizni biladigan ikki ustoz

ladder.en: Two who have seen a piece of your own work
ladder.uz: Sizning o‘z ishingizni ko‘rgan ikki ustoz

ladder.en: Two who can describe a moment where you went beyond the class
ladder.uz: Darsdan tashqariga chiqqan lahzangizni tasvirlay oladigan ikki ustoz

title.en: Get your documents ready before you need them
title.uz: Hujjatlarni kerak bo‘lishidan oldin tayyorlang

what.en: Translations, notarisation, apostille and equivalence take weeks. Late documents sink otherwise good applications.
what.uz: Tarjima, notarial tasdiq, apostil va ekvivalentlik haftalab vaqt oladi. Kechikkan hujjatlar yaxshi arizani ham yo‘qqa chiqaradi.

steps.en: List every document your targets ask for (use the university pages in EduBridge)
steps.uz: Maqsadlaringiz so‘raydigan barcha hujjatlarni yozing (EduBridge’dagi universitet sahifalaridan)

steps.en: Order transcripts and certified/notarised translations
steps.uz: Transkript va tasdiqlangan/notarial tarjimalarga buyurtma bering

steps.en: Check apostille or legalisation rules for each country
steps.uz: Har bir davlat uchun apostil yoki legalizatsiya qoidasini tekshiring

steps.en: Scan everything to clear PDFs and name files consistently
steps.uz: Hammasini aniq PDF’ga skanerlang va fayllarni bir xil nomlang

pitfall.en: Translating before checking which translation type each country accepts (e.g. uni-assist asks for notarised translations from Uzbekistan).
pitfall.uz: Har bir davlat qaysi tarjima turini qabul qilishini tekshirmasdan tarjima qildirish (masalan, uni-assist O‘zbekistondan notarial tarjima so‘raydi).

evidence.en: A checklist with dates, the scanned files.

ladder.en: Passport and transcripts ready
All translations and certifications done
A complete, named PDF set for each application
ladder.uz: Har bir ariza uchun to‘liq, nomlangan PDF to‘plam

title.en: Prepare seriously for a subject olympiad
title.uz: Fan olimpiadasiga jiddiy tayyorlaning

what.en: District → regional → national rounds. Even reaching a later round shows depth in a way grades cannot.
what.uz: Tuman → viloyat → respublika bosqichlari. Keyingi bosqichga chiqish ham baholar ko‘rsata olmaydigan chuqurlikni ko‘rsatadi.

steps.en: Ask your teacher for this year’s round dates and past papers
steps.uz: Ustozingizdan bu yilgi bosqich sanalari va o‘tgan yilgi savollarni so‘rang

steps.en: Solve past papers under time limits every week
steps.uz: Har hafta o‘tgan savollarni vaqt chegarasida yeching

steps.en: Keep an error log and redo every missed problem a week later
steps.uz: Xatolar daftarini yuriting va har bir xatoni bir haftadan keyin qayta yeching

steps.en: Find one study partner or a teacher for hard problems
steps.uz: Qiyin masalalar uchun bitta hamkor yoki ustoz toping

cv.en: [Subject] Olympiad — [round] stage, [place/certificate], [year]
cv.uz: [Fan] olimpiadasi — [bosqich], [o‘rin/sertifikat], [yil]

angle.en: Write about how you handled a problem you could not solve at first — not about the medal.
angle.uz: Medal haqida emas, avval yecha olmagan masalangizni qanday hal qilganingiz haqida yozing.

pitfall.en: Listing “participant” without a round or result reads as filler.
pitfall.uz: Bosqich yoki natijasiz “ishtirokchi” deb yozish to‘ldiruvchi bo‘lib ko‘rinadi.

evidence.en: Certificates, official results lists, your error log.
evidence.uz: Sertifikatlar, rasmiy natijalar ro‘yxati, xatolar daftaringiz.

ladder.en: Reached the regional round
Placed at regional level
National round or a national placing

title.en: Finish one demanding university-level online course in your subject
title.uz: Sohangiz bo‘yicha bitta jiddiy universitet darajasidagi onlayn kursni tugating

what.en: One hard, relevant course with graded assignments beats five short certificates.
what.uz: Baholanadigan topshiriqlari bor bitta qiyin, mos kurs beshta qisqa sertifikatdan kuchliroq.

steps.en: Pick one university-level course on Coursera, edX or a university’s open courseware close to your degree
steps.uz: Coursera, edX yoki universitet ochiq kurslaridan darajangizga yaqin bitta kursni tanlang

steps.en: Block fixed weekly hours and do every graded exercise
steps.uz: Haftalik aniq soatlar ajrating va har bir baholanadigan mashqni bajaring

steps.en: Write a one-page summary of what you could now do that you could not before
steps.uz: Endi avval qila olmagan nimani qila olishingiz haqida bir betlik xulosa yozing

steps.en: Apply one idea from it to a small problem of your own
steps.uz: Undagi bitta g‘oyani o‘zingizning kichik masalangizga qo‘llang

cv.en: [Course name], [university/platform] — completed [month year]; applied it to [mini-project]
cv.uz: [Kurs nomi], [universitet/platforma] — [oy yil] da tugatilgan; [mini-loyiha]ga qo‘llandi

angle.en: Use it as evidence of a specific interest (“after the course on X I wanted to know Y”).
angle.uz: Aniq qiziqish dalili sifatida ishlating (“X kursidan keyin Y ni bilgim keldi”).

pitfall.en: Collecting many easy certificates — readers discount them heavily.
pitfall.uz: Ko‘p oson sertifikat yig‘ish — o‘quvchilar ularni deyarli hisobga olmaydi.

evidence.en: Certificate or completion record, your graded work, the mini-project.

ladder.en: One completed course
Completed with graded assignments and a mini-project
ladder.uz: Baholangan topshiriqlar va mini-loyiha bilan tugatilgan

ladder.en: A sequence of 2–3 courses building to a real project
ladder.uz: Haqiqiy loyihaga olib boruvchi 2–3 kurs ketma-ketligi

title.en: Keep a serious reading log in your field
title.uz: Sohangiz bo‘yicha jiddiy o‘qish kundaligini yuriting

what.en: Interviews and essays for humanities, law and social sciences often ask what you have read and what you think about it.
what.uz: Gumanitar, huquq va ijtimoiy fanlarda suhbat va insholar ko‘pincha nimani o‘qiganingiz va u haqda nima deb o‘ylashingizni so‘raydi.

steps.en: Choose 6–8 books or long articles beyond the school syllabus
steps.uz: Maktab dasturidan tashqari 6–8 ta kitob yoki uzun maqola tanlang

steps.en: After each, write half a page: the argument, one thing you disagree with, a question it raised
steps.uz: Har biridan keyin yarim bet yozing: asosiy fikr, rozi bo‘lmagan bitta joy, tug‘ilgan savol

steps.en: Discuss one of them with a teacher
steps.uz: Bittasini ustoz bilan muhokama qiling

steps.en: Turn the best note into a short public essay
steps.uz: Eng yaxshi qaydni qisqa ochiq inshoga aylantiring

cv.en: Independent reading programme in [field] ([n] works, with written reviews)
cv.uz: [Soha] bo‘yicha mustaqil o‘qish dasturi ([n] asar, yozma sharhlar bilan)

angle.en: A strong interview or essay hook: “reading X changed how I saw Y”.
angle.uz: Kuchli suhbat yoki insho boshlanishi: “X ni o‘qish Y ga qarashimni o‘zgartirdi”.

pitfall.en: Listing famous titles you cannot discuss — interviewers will ask.
pitfall.uz: Muhokama qila olmaydigan mashhur nomlarni sanash — suhbatda so‘rashadi.

evidence.en: The written notes, the published essay.

ladder.en: 6 works with short notes
Notes plus one published essay
ladder.uz: Qaydlar va bitta e’lon qilingan insho

ladder.en: A sustained question you can discuss in depth across several works
ladder.uz: Bir nechta asar orqali chuqur muhokama qila oladigan barqaror savol

title.en: Build software that real people use
title.uz: Haqiqiy odamlar foydalanadigan dastur yarating

what.en: A small tool with real users says more than a big unfinished project.
what.uz: Haqiqiy foydalanuvchilari bor kichik vosita katta, tugallanmagan loyihadan ko‘proq gapiradi.

steps.en: Find one annoying task for people around you (a club, a shop, your class)
steps.uz: Atrofingizdagilar uchun bitta zerikarli vazifani toping (to‘garak, do‘kon, sinf)

steps.en: Build the smallest version that solves it in 3–4 weeks
steps.uz: 3–4 haftada uni hal qiladigan eng kichik versiyani yarating

steps.en: Get 5–10 people to use it and collect their feedback
steps.uz: 5–10 kishiga foydalanib ko‘rishni so‘rang va fikrlarini yig‘ing

steps.en: Publish the code on GitHub with a clear README and screenshots
steps.uz: Kodni aniq README va skrinshotlar bilan GitHub’da e’lon qiling

cv.en: Built [tool] for [users] in [language/stack]; used by [n] people; [result, e.g. saved x hours a week]
cv.uz: [Foydalanuvchilar] uchun [til/stek]da [vosita] yaratildi; [n] kishi foydalanadi; [natija, masalan haftasiga x soat tejaldi]

angle.en: Write about a decision you changed after users tried it.
angle.uz: Foydalanuvchilar sinab ko‘rgach o‘zgartirgan qaroringiz haqida yozing.

pitfall.en: A tutorial clone (to-do app, calculator) with no users shows little.
pitfall.uz: Foydalanuvchisiz darslik nusxasi (to-do ilova, kalkulyator) kam narsa ko‘rsatadi.

evidence.en: GitHub repository, README, user feedback, usage numbers.
evidence.uz: GitHub repozitoriy, README, foydalanuvchi fikrlari, foydalanish raqamlari.

ladder.en: Working tool used by a few people
ladder.uz: Bir necha kishi ishlatadigan ishlaydigan vosita

ladder.en: Regular users and an improvement driven by their feedback
ladder.uz: Doimiy foydalanuvchilar va ularning fikri asosida yaxshilanish

ladder.en: Adopted by an organisation or used by 100+ people
ladder.uz: Tashkilot qabul qilgan yoki 100+ kishi ishlatadi

title.en: A data analysis on a real dataset (e.g. Kaggle or data.gov.uz)
title.uz: Haqiqiy ma’lumotlar tahlili (masalan, Kaggle yoki data.gov.uz)

what.en: Ask one clear question of real data, answer it honestly, and explain the limits.
what.uz: Haqiqiy ma’lumotga bitta aniq savol bering, unga halol javob toping va cheklovlarini tushuntiring.

steps.en: Choose a dataset you care about — Uzbekistan’s open data portal (data.gov.uz) or a Kaggle dataset
steps.uz: O‘zingizni qiziqtirgan ma’lumotlar to‘plamini tanlang — O‘zbekiston ochiq ma’lumotlar portali (data.gov.uz) yoki Kaggle

steps.en: Write one question you can answer with it
steps.uz: U bilan javob berish mumkin bo‘lgan bitta savol yozing

steps.en: Clean the data, analyse it, and make 3–4 clear charts
steps.uz: Ma’lumotni tozalang, tahlil qiling va 3–4 ta aniq grafik tuzing

steps.en: Publish a notebook or short report with your conclusion and its limitations
steps.uz: Xulosa va cheklovlari bilan notebook yoki qisqa hisobot e’lon qiling

cv.en: Analysed [dataset] to answer [question]; found [result]; published at [link]
cv.uz: [Savol]ga javob berish uchun [ma’lumotlar] tahlil qilindi; [natija] aniqlandi; [havola]da e’lon qilingan

angle.en: Good for “why this subject”: a question you could not answer without the degree’s methods.
angle.uz: “Nega bu soha” uchun yaxshi: daraja usullarisiz javob bera olmagan savolingiz.

pitfall.en: Copying a popular notebook; readers recognise them.
pitfall.uz: Mashhur notebookni ko‘chirish; o‘quvchilar ularni taniydi.

evidence.en: The notebook/report, the data source.

ladder.en: A clean notebook answering one question
ladder.uz: Bitta savolga javob beradigan toza notebook

ladder.en: A report someone outside your class found useful
ladder.uz: Sinfingizdan tashqaridagi kimgadir foydali bo‘lgan hisobot

ladder.en: A competition ranking or analysis used by an organisation
ladder.uz: Musobaqa reytingi yoki tashkilot foydalangan tahlil

title.en: Design and build a working device that solves a local problem
title.uz: Mahalliy muammoni hal qiluvchi ishlaydigan qurilmani loyihalab yasang

what.en: Engineering readers want to see that you can go from a problem to a tested prototype.
what.uz: Muhandislik o‘quvchilari muammodan sinovdan o‘tgan prototipgacha bora olishingizni ko‘rishni istaydi.

steps.en: Pick a concrete problem (water use, energy, irrigation, home safety)
steps.uz: Aniq muammoni tanlang (suv sarfi, energiya, sug‘orish, uy xavfsizligi)

steps.en: Sketch the design and estimate cost before buying parts
steps.uz: Qism sotib olishdan oldin loyiha chizing va narxini hisoblang

steps.en: Build a prototype, test it, and record measurements
steps.uz: Prototip yasang, sinang va o‘lchovlarni yozib boring

steps.en: Write up what failed and what you changed
steps.uz: Nima ishlamagani va nimani o‘zgartirganingizni yozing

cv.en: Designed and built [device] to [purpose]; tested over [period]; [measured result]
cv.uz: [Maqsad] uchun [qurilma] loyihalanib yasaldi; [davr] davomida sinaldi; [o‘lchangan natija]

angle.en: The failure and redesign is the most convincing part.
angle.uz: Muvaffaqiyatsizlik va qayta loyihalash eng ishonarli qism.

pitfall.en: Following a kit’s instructions step by step — that is assembly, not design.
pitfall.uz: To‘plam yo‘riqnomasiga bosqichma-bosqich amal qilish — bu loyihalash emas, yig‘ish.

evidence.en: Photos/video, measurements, design notes, a short report.
evidence.uz: Foto/video, o‘lchovlar, loyiha qaydlari, qisqa hisobot.

ladder.en: A working prototype with notes
Tested with measured results and one redesign
ladder.uz: O‘lchangan natijalar va bitta qayta loyihalash bilan sinalgan

ladder.en: Used in a real setting (a home, a farm, a school) with results
ladder.uz: Haqiqiy joyda (uy, ferma, maktab) natijalar bilan ishlatilgan

title.en: Analyse a real company or market and publish your view
title.uz: Haqiqiy kompaniya yoki bozorni tahlil qilib, fikringizni e’lon qiling

what.en: For business, finance and economics, a written analysis with numbers shows you can think like the field.
what.uz: Biznes, moliya va iqtisod uchun raqamli yozma tahlil soha kabi fikrlay olishingizni ko‘rsatadi.

steps.en: Choose a listed company, a bank or a local market you can find public data on
steps.uz: Ochiq ma’lumot topa oladigan birja kompaniyasi, bank yoki mahalliy bozorni tanlang

steps.en: Read its annual report or official statistics; build a simple spreadsheet
steps.uz: Yillik hisobot yoki rasmiy statistikani o‘qing; oddiy jadval tuzing

steps.en: Write a 3–5 page analysis: what is happening, why, what could go wrong
steps.uz: 3–5 betlik tahlil yozing: nima bo‘lyapti, nega, nima xato ketishi mumkin

steps.en: Ask a teacher or a professional to critique it, then revise and publish
steps.uz: Ustoz yoki mutaxassisdan tanqid so‘rang, qayta ishlab e’lon qiling

cv.en: Independent analysis of [company/market]: [main finding]; reviewed by [role]; published at [link]
cv.uz: [Kompaniya/bozor] mustaqil tahlili: [asosiy xulosa]; [lavozim] ko‘rib chiqqan; [havola]da e’lon qilingan

angle.en: Explain the question that made you curious and what the numbers changed in your view.
angle.uz: Qiziqtirgan savolni va raqamlar fikringizni qanday o‘zgartirganini tushuntiring.

pitfall.en: Summarising news articles without your own numbers or judgement.
pitfall.uz: O‘z raqam va xulosangizsiz yangiliklarni qisqartirib yozish.

evidence.en: The report, the spreadsheet, the reviewer’s comments.

ladder.en: A clear written analysis with your own spreadsheet
ladder.uz: O‘z jadvalingiz bilan aniq yozma tahlil

ladder.en: Reviewed and revised; published
ladder.uz: Ko‘rib chiqilgan, qayta ishlangan va e’lon qilingan

ladder.en: Used or discussed by a club, a company or a competition panel
ladder.uz: To‘garak, kompaniya yoki tanlov hay’ati foydalangan yoki muhokama qilgan

title.en: A health-awareness project with a measurable result
title.uz: O‘lchanadigan natijali sog‘liq haqida xabardorlik loyihasi

what.en: Medicine and public-health readers look for care for patients plus scientific thinking. Never give medical advice yourself.
what.uz: Tibbiyot va jamoat salomatligi o‘quvchilari bemorga g‘amxo‘rlik va ilmiy fikrlashni izlaydi. O‘zingiz hech qachon tibbiy maslahat bermang.

steps.en: Choose one topic with a trusted source (e.g. hand-washing, first aid, sleep) and ask a doctor or nurse to check your material
steps.uz: Ishonchli manbali bitta mavzuni tanlang (qo‘l yuvish, birinchi yordam, uyqu) va materialingizni shifokor yoki hamshiraga tekshirtiring

steps.en: Run 2–3 short sessions at a school or mahalla
steps.uz: Maktab yoki mahallada 2–3 qisqa mashg‘ulot o‘tkazing

steps.en: Measure knowledge before and after with a short quiz
steps.uz: Bilimni oldin va keyin qisqa test bilan o‘lchang

steps.en: Write up the results honestly
steps.uz: Natijalarni halol yozing

cv.en: Ran [n] health-education sessions on [topic] for [audience], reviewed by [role]; quiz scores rose from [x] to [y]
cv.uz: [Auditoriya] uchun [mavzu] bo‘yicha [n] ta sog‘liq mashg‘uloti o‘tkazildi, [lavozim] tekshirgan; test natijalari [x] dan [y] ga oshdi

angle.en: A conversation with one participant that changed how you see healthcare.
angle.uz: Sog‘liqni saqlashga qarashingizni o‘zgartirgan bitta ishtirokchi bilan suhbat.

pitfall.en: Presenting yourself as giving medical care, or using photos of people without consent.
pitfall.uz: O‘zingizni tibbiy yordam ko‘rsatgandek ko‘rsatish yoki odamlar suratini roziliksiz ishlatish.

evidence.en: Materials, before/after results, the reviewer’s note.

ladder.en: One session with feedback
Several sessions with before/after results
ladder.uz: Oldin/keyin natijalari bilan bir necha mashg‘ulot

ladder.en: A school or clinic keeps using your material
ladder.uz: Maktab yoki poliklinika materialingizdan foydalanishda davom etmoqda

title.en: Build a focused portfolio of 8–12 pieces
title.uz: 8–12 ishdan iborat aniq portfolio yarating

what.en: Art, design and architecture programmes often judge the portfolio more than grades. Quality and process beat quantity.
what.uz: San’at, dizayn va arxitektura dasturlari ko‘pincha baholardan ko‘ra portfolioga qaraydi. Miqdordan ko‘ra sifat va jarayon muhim.

steps.en: Read each target programme’s portfolio rules (size, format, number of pieces)
steps.uz: Har bir maqsad dasturining portfolio qoidalarini o‘qing (o‘lcham, format, ishlar soni)

steps.en: Choose a theme and make new work for it, showing sketches and process
steps.uz: Mavzu tanlab, uning uchun eskiz va jarayonni ko‘rsatgan holda yangi ishlar yarating

steps.en: Get critique from a teacher or practising designer
steps.uz: Ustoz yoki amaliyotchi dizaynerdan tanqid oling

steps.en: Lay it out cleanly as a PDF and a simple website
steps.uz: PDF va oddiy veb-sayt sifatida toza joylashtiring

cv.en: Portfolio: [n] works on [theme], including [best project]
cv.uz: Portfolio: [mavzu] bo‘yicha [n] ta ish, jumladan [eng yaxshi loyiha]

angle.en: Explain the idea behind one project and what you would do differently.
angle.uz: Bitta loyiha g‘oyasini va nimani boshqacha qilgan bo‘lishingizni tushuntiring.

pitfall.en: Including everything you ever made; weak pieces pull the strong ones down.
pitfall.uz: Hamma qilgan ishingizni qo‘shish; zaif ishlar kuchlilarni pastga tortadi.

evidence.en: The portfolio PDF and website, process sketches.
evidence.uz: Portfolio PDF va sayti, jarayon eskizlari.

ladder.en: A coherent set of finished pieces
Clear process for each piece and outside critique
ladder.uz: Har bir ish uchun aniq jarayon va tashqi tanqid

ladder.en: Work exhibited, published or used by a client
ladder.uz: Ko‘rgazmaga qo‘yilgan, e’lon qilingan yoki mijoz foydalangan ishlar

title.en: Run a small, fair field or garden trial
title.uz: Kichik, adolatli dala yoki tomorqa tajribasini o‘tkazing

what.en: Compare two methods (watering, seed, fertiliser) on equal plots and measure the result — real agricultural science.
what.uz: Ikki usulni (sug‘orish, urug‘, o‘g‘it) teng maydonlarda solishtiring va natijani o‘lchang — haqiqiy agrar fan.

steps.en: Pick one variable to test and keep everything else equal
steps.uz: Sinaladigan bitta o‘zgaruvchini tanlang va qolganini teng saqlang

steps.en: Mark at least two plots per method
steps.uz: Har bir usul uchun kamida ikki maydon belgilang

steps.en: Record measurements on a fixed schedule
steps.uz: O‘lchovlarni aniq jadval bo‘yicha yozing

steps.en: Analyse and write a 3–4 page report with photos
steps.uz: Tahlil qiling va suratlar bilan 3–4 betlik hisobot yozing

cv.en: Field trial comparing [A] and [B] on [crop] over [period]; [measured difference]
cv.uz: [Davr] davomida [ekin]da [A] va [B] ni solishtiruvchi dala tajribasi; [o‘lchangan farq]

angle.en: Link it to a farming problem you have seen in your region.
angle.uz: Hududingizda ko‘rgan dehqonchilik muammosiga bog‘lang.

pitfall.en: One plot per method — differences may be luck.
pitfall.uz: Har usulga bitta maydon — farq tasodif bo‘lishi mumkin.

evidence.en: The data sheet, photos, the report.

ladder.en: A completed trial with notes
Repeated or replicated with a clear write-up
Results shared with farmers who then tried them
ladder.uz: Natijalar dehqonlarga ulashilgan va ular sinab ko‘rgan

title.en: Debate, Model UN or a moot-court style exercise
title.uz: Debat, Model UN yoki sud-o‘yin mashqi

what.en: Arguing both sides under rules and time pressure is the core skill of law, politics and international relations.
what.uz: Qoidalar va vaqt bosimida ikkala tomonni himoya qilish — huquq, siyosat va xalqaro munosabatlarning asosiy ko‘nikmasi.

steps.en: Join or start a debate or Model UN group at school or university
steps.uz: Maktab yoki universitetda debat yoki Model UN guruhiga qo‘shiling yoki uni boshlang

steps.en: Prepare one case properly: sources, both sides, rebuttals
steps.uz: Bitta ishni to‘liq tayyorlang: manbalar, ikkala tomon, raddiyalar

steps.en: Take part in at least two formal rounds
steps.uz: Kamida ikkita rasmiy raundda qatnashing

steps.en: Ask the judges for written feedback and work on one weakness
steps.uz: Hakamlardan yozma fikr so‘rang va bitta zaif tomon ustida ishlang

cv.en: [Debate/Model UN] — [role], [event], [result/award]; prepared position on [topic]
cv.uz: [Debat/Model UN] — [rol], [tadbir], [natija/mukofot]; [mavzu] bo‘yicha pozitsiya tayyorlangan

angle.en: A time you had to argue a side you disagreed with.
angle.uz: Rozi bo‘lmagan tomonni himoya qilishingizga to‘g‘ri kelgan holat.

pitfall.en: Attending once for a certificate; depth across several rounds matters.
pitfall.uz: Sertifikat uchun bir marta qatnashish; bir necha raund davomida chuqurlik muhim.

evidence.en: Position papers, results, judge feedback.

ladder.en: Took part in formal rounds
Won rounds or a speaker award
ladder.uz: Raund yoki eng yaxshi notiq mukofotini yutgan

ladder.en: Organised a debate event or coached newer members
ladder.uz: Debat tadbirini tashkil qilgan yoki yangi a’zolarga murabbiylik qilgan

title.en: Teach a short course and measure learning
title.uz: Qisqa kurs o‘tib, o‘rganishni o‘lchang

what.en: For education (and any field), teaching shows you understand a subject well enough to explain it.
what.uz: Ta’lim (va har qanday soha) uchun dars berish fanni tushuntira oladigan darajada bilishingizni ko‘rsatadi.

steps.en: Offer a 4–6 week free course (maths, English, coding) for younger students
steps.uz: Kichiklar uchun 4–6 haftalik bepul kurs taklif qiling (matematika, ingliz tili, dasturlash)

steps.en: Plan each lesson with one clear learning goal
steps.uz: Har bir darsni bitta aniq o‘quv maqsadi bilan rejalang

steps.en: Test at the start and the end
steps.uz: Boshida va oxirida test o‘tkazing

steps.en: Collect anonymous feedback and change one thing mid-way
steps.uz: Anonim fikr yig‘ing va o‘rtada bitta narsani o‘zgartiring

cv.en: Designed and taught a [n]-week [subject] course for [n] students; average test score rose from [x] to [y]
cv.uz: [n] o‘quvchi uchun [n] haftalik [fan] kursi tuzildi va o‘tildi; o‘rtacha test bali [x] dan [y] ga oshdi

angle.en: One student who struggled and what you changed for them.
angle.uz: Qiynalgan bitta o‘quvchi va u uchun nimani o‘zgartirganingiz.

pitfall.en: Claiming impact without before/after evidence.
pitfall.uz: Oldin/keyin dalilisiz natija haqida da’vo qilish.

evidence.en: Lesson plans, test results, feedback.

ladder.en: One completed course
Measured improvement and feedback
Repeated with new groups or handed to another teacher
ladder.uz: Yangi guruhlar bilan takrorlangan yoki boshqa ustozga topshirilgan

title.en: A small research project with a teacher or lecturer
title.uz: Ustoz yoki o‘qituvchi bilan kichik tadqiqot loyihasi

what.en: A narrow question, real data and an honest write-up — the best preparation for research-based programmes.
what.uz: Tor savol, haqiqiy ma’lumot va halol yozilgan natija — tadqiqotga asoslangan dasturlar uchun eng yaxshi tayyorgarlik.

steps.en: Ask a teacher/lecturer for a narrow question they find interesting
steps.uz: Ustoz/o‘qituvchidan uni qiziqtiradigan tor savol so‘rang

steps.en: Read 5–10 sources and write a one-page plan
steps.uz: 5–10 manba o‘qib, bir betlik reja yozing

steps.en: Collect a small amount of real data (survey, interviews, measurements, open data)
steps.uz: Oz miqdorda haqiqiy ma’lumot yig‘ing (so‘rovnoma, suhbat, o‘lchov, ochiq ma’lumot)

steps.en: Write 6–10 pages with methods, results and limitations; present it
steps.uz: Usul, natija va cheklovlar bilan 6–10 bet yozing; taqdim eting

cv.en: Research project: [question], supervised by [role]; [method]; [finding]; presented at [where]
cv.uz: Tadqiqot loyihasi: [savol], rahbar [lavozim]; [usul]; [natija]; [qayerda] taqdim etilgan

angle.en: Strong for study plans and research proposals — explain what you would study next.
angle.uz: O‘qish rejasi va tadqiqot taklifi uchun kuchli — keyin nimani o‘rganmoqchi ekaningizni tushuntiring.

pitfall.en: A “research paper” that only summarises the internet.
pitfall.uz: Faqat internetni qisqartirgan “ilmiy maqola”.

evidence.en: The paper, the supervisor’s comments, the presentation.

ladder.en: A completed paper with a supervisor
Presented at a school/university conference
Accepted in a student journal or conference
ladder.uz: Talabalar jurnali yoki konferensiyasida qabul qilingan

title.en: Turn your bachelor’s thesis into a short paper
title.uz: Bakalavr bitiruv ishingizni qisqa maqolaga aylantiring

what.en: For master’s applications, a polished paper from your thesis is the strongest research evidence most applicants can produce.
what.uz: Magistratura arizalari uchun bitiruv ishidan tayyorlangan sayqallangan maqola ko‘pchilik abituriyent bera oladigan eng kuchli tadqiqot dalili.

steps.en: Cut the thesis to one clear question and its best result
steps.uz: Bitiruv ishini bitta aniq savol va eng yaxshi natijaga qisqartiring

steps.en: Rewrite to 4,000–6,000 words in journal style
steps.uz: Jurnal uslubida 4 000–6 000 so‘zga qayta yozing

steps.en: Ask your supervisor for comments; fix the methods section first
steps.uz: Rahbardan izoh so‘rang; avval usullar bo‘limini tuzating

steps.en: Submit to a student journal or conference, or post it as a working paper
steps.uz: Talabalar jurnali yoki konferensiyasiga yuboring yoki working paper sifatida joylang

cv.en: “[Title]”, [journal/conference or working paper], [year]
cv.uz: “[Sarlavha]”, [jurnal/konferensiya yoki working paper], [yil]

angle.en: Your research proposal can start where this paper ends.
angle.uz: Tadqiqot taklifingiz shu maqola tugagan joydan boshlanishi mumkin.

pitfall.en: Submitting to fake “predatory” journals that publish anything for a fee.
pitfall.uz: Pulga hamma narsani chop etadigan soxta (“predatory”) jurnallarga yuborish.

evidence.en: The paper, submission confirmation, supervisor comments.

ladder.en: Polished paper with supervisor comments
Posted as a working paper or presented
ladder.uz: Working paper sifatida joylangan yoki taqdim etilgan

ladder.en: Accepted by a reviewed student journal or conference
ladder.uz: Taqrizli talabalar jurnali yoki konferensiyasida qabul qilingan

title.en: Work as a research assistant for a lecturer or think tank
title.uz: O‘qituvchi yoki tahliliy markazda ilmiy yordamchi bo‘ling

what.en: Even unpaid assistance on a real project gives you methods, a strong recommender and something concrete to discuss.
what.uz: Haqiqiy loyihadagi hatto pulsiz yordam ham usullar, kuchli tavsiya beruvchi va muhokama uchun aniq mavzu beradi.

steps.en: List 5 lecturers or research centres working near your interest
steps.uz: Qiziqishingizga yaqin ishlaydigan 5 o‘qituvchi yoki tadqiqot markazini yozing

steps.en: Email each with a short note: what you can do (data entry, literature review, coding) and your hours
steps.uz: Har biriga qisqa xat yozing: nima qila olasiz (ma’lumot kiritish, adabiyot sharhi, dasturlash) va soatlaringiz

steps.en: Agree a concrete task and deadline
steps.uz: Aniq vazifa va muddatni kelishing

steps.en: Ask for a reference once the task is done well
steps.uz: Vazifa yaxshi bajarilgach tavsiya so‘rang

cv.en: Research assistant, [centre/lecturer] ([dates]): [task, e.g. built a dataset of n …]
cv.uz: Ilmiy yordamchi, [markaz/o‘qituvchi] ([sanalar]): [vazifa, masalan n … dan iborat ma’lumotlar bazasi tuzildi]

angle.en: What the project taught you about how research is actually done.
angle.uz: Loyiha sizga tadqiqot aslida qanday qilinishini qanday o‘rgatgani.

pitfall.en: Vague roles (“helped with research”) — name the task and output.
pitfall.uz: Noaniq rollar (“tadqiqotga yordam berdi”) — vazifa va natijani nomlang.

evidence.en: The dataset/report you contributed to, a supervisor’s letter.

ladder.en: A defined task completed
A credited contribution (acknowledgement or co-authorship)
A strong letter from a researcher who knows your work

title.en: Contribute to a citizen-science project (e.g. Zooniverse)
title.uz: Fuqarolik ilmi loyihasiga hissa qo‘shing (masalan, Zooniverse)

what.en: An easy start into real research: classify data for live scientific projects, then go one step further.
what.uz: Haqiqiy tadqiqotga oson boshlanish: jonli ilmiy loyihalar uchun ma’lumotlarni tasniflang, keyin bir qadam oldinga yuring.

steps.en: Choose a project close to your subject on Zooniverse or a similar platform
steps.uz: Zooniverse yoki shunga o‘xshash platformada fanga yaqin loyihani tanlang

steps.en: Contribute regularly for a month
steps.uz: Bir oy muntazam hissa qo‘shing

steps.en: Read one paper the project produced
steps.uz: Loyiha natijasida chiqqan bitta maqolani o‘qing

steps.en: Write a short reflection: what the scientists asked and how your data helped
steps.uz: Qisqa mulohaza yozing: olimlar nimani so‘radi va ma’lumotingiz qanday yordam berdi

cv.en: Citizen-science volunteer, [project] — [n] classifications; [reflection link]
cv.uz: Fuqarolik ilmi ko‘ngillisi, [loyiha] — [n] ta tasniflash; [mulohaza havolasi]

angle.en: Only as a starting point — say what it made you want to study.
angle.uz: Faqat boshlanish nuqtasi sifatida — u sizni nimani o‘rganishga undaganini ayting.

pitfall.en: Listing it alone as “research experience” overstates it.
pitfall.uz: Uni yolg‘iz “tadqiqot tajribasi” deb yozish oshirib yuborish bo‘ladi.

evidence.en: Contribution count/profile, the reflection.

ladder.en: Regular contributions
A written reflection linked to a paper
Used it to start your own small question
ladder.uz: Undan o‘z kichik savolingizni boshlash uchun foydalangan

title.en: Start or lead a subject club with a concrete output
title.uz: Aniq natijali fan to‘garagini boshlang yoki boshqaring

what.en: Leadership counts when something exists because of you — not because you held a title.
what.uz: Yetakchilik siz tufayli nimadir paydo bo‘lganda hisoblanadi — lavozim egallaganingiz uchun emas.

steps.en: Find 4–6 people with a shared interest
steps.uz: Umumiy qiziqishga ega 4–6 kishini toping

steps.en: Agree one concrete goal for the term (an event, a publication, a competition team)
steps.uz: Chorak uchun bitta aniq maqsad kelishing (tadbir, nashr, tanlov jamoasi)

steps.en: Divide roles and meet weekly
steps.uz: Rollarni taqsimlang va har hafta uchrashing

steps.en: Deliver the output and hand the club to a successor
steps.uz: Natijani bering va to‘garakni vorisga topshiring

cv.en: Founder/lead, [club] ([dates]): grew to [n] members; organised [output]
cv.uz: Asoschi/rahbar, [to‘garak] ([sanalar]): [n] a’zoga yetdi; [natija] tashkil qilindi

angle.en: A conflict or setback in the team and how you handled it.
angle.uz: Jamoadagi nizo yoki muvaffaqiyatsizlik va uni qanday hal qilganingiz.

pitfall.en: A title with no output (“president of a club that met twice”).
pitfall.uz: Natijasiz lavozim (“ikki marta yig‘ilgan to‘garak prezidenti”).

evidence.en: Event photos, attendance, the output itself, a teacher’s note.
evidence.uz: Tadbir suratlari, qatnashuv, natijaning o‘zi, ustoz izohi.

ladder.en: A club that met regularly
A completed output with numbers
Still running after you left, with a new leader
ladder.uz: Siz ketgandan keyin ham yangi rahbar bilan ishlamoqda

title.en: Sustained volunteering with one organisation
title.uz: Bitta tashkilotda barqaror ko‘ngillilik

what.en: Six months in one place, with growing responsibility, beats ten one-day events.
what.uz: Bir joyda olti oy, ortib boruvchi mas’uliyat bilan — o‘nta bir kunlik tadbirdan kuchliroq.

steps.en: Choose one organisation (library, NGO, hospital volunteer service, student community) linked to your interests
steps.uz: Qiziqishlaringizga bog‘liq bitta tashkilotni tanlang (kutubxona, NNT, kasalxona ko‘ngillilari, talabalar jamoasi)

steps.en: Commit to a fixed weekly slot
steps.uz: Haftalik aniq vaqtga majburiyat oling

steps.en: After 2 months, ask for a task with more responsibility
steps.uz: 2 oydan keyin mas’uliyatliroq vazifa so‘rang

steps.en: Keep an hours log and ask the coordinator for a letter at the end
steps.uz: Soatlar jurnalini yuriting va oxirida koordinatordan xat so‘rang

cv.en: Volunteer, [organisation] ([dates], ~[n] hours): [responsibility]; [result]
cv.uz: Ko‘ngilli, [tashkilot] ([sanalar], ~[n] soat): [mas’uliyat]; [natija]

angle.en: A specific person or moment, and what it taught you — not “I learned to help people”.
angle.uz: Aniq odam yoki lahza va u sizga nimani o‘rgatgani — “odamlarga yordam berishni o‘rgandim” emas.

pitfall.en: Many one-off events listed separately.
pitfall.uz: Ko‘p bir martalik tadbirlarni alohida sanash.

evidence.en: Hours log, coordinator’s letter, examples of results.
evidence.uz: Soatlar jurnali, koordinator xati, natija misollari.

ladder.en: Regular volunteering for 3+ months
Promoted to a task with responsibility
Led a new activity there

title.en: Solve one small problem in your mahalla or school — and measure it
title.uz: Mahalla yoki maktabingizdagi bitta kichik muammoni hal qiling — va o‘lchang

what.en: Scholarship panels (e.g. those looking for leadership and contribution) respond to a real problem, a real action and a number.
what.uz: Grant hay’atlari (masalan, yetakchilik va hissani izlaydiganlar) haqiqiy muammo, haqiqiy harakat va raqamga e’tibor beradi.

steps.en: Talk to 10 people affected and write down the problem in their words
steps.uz: Muammoga duch kelgan 10 kishi bilan gaplashing va muammoni ularning so‘zlari bilan yozing

steps.en: Choose one small action you can finish in 6–8 weeks
steps.uz: 6–8 haftada tugata oladigan bitta kichik harakatni tanlang

steps.en: Measure the situation before and after
steps.uz: Vaziyatni oldin va keyin o‘lchang

steps.en: Write a one-page report and share it with the people involved
steps.uz: Bir betlik hisobot yozing va ishtirokchilarga ulashing

cv.en: Initiated [action] to address [problem] in [place]; [before → after number]; [n] people involved
cv.uz: [Joy]dagi [muammo]ni hal qilish uchun [harakat] boshlandi; [oldin → keyin raqam]; [n] kishi jalb qilindi

angle.en: The best material for “contribution” or “leadership” essays — tell it as a story with your role clear.
angle.uz: “Hissa” yoki “yetakchilik” insholari uchun eng yaxshi material — rolingiz aniq bo‘lgan hikoya qilib yozing.

pitfall.en: Big claims (“changed my community”) with no number.
pitfall.uz: Raqamsiz katta da’volar (“jamiyatimni o‘zgartirdim”).

evidence.en: Before/after data, photos with consent, letters from partners.
evidence.uz: Oldin/keyin ma’lumotlar, rozilik bilan suratlar, hamkorlar xatlari.

ladder.en: Completed action with feedback
Measured result and a partner
Continued or copied by others

title.en: Mentor younger students through exams or applications
title.uz: Kichiklarga imtihon yoki arizada murabbiylik qiling

what.en: Helping others prepare shows responsibility and deepens your own understanding.
what.uz: Boshqalarni tayyorlashga yordam berish mas’uliyatni ko‘rsatadi va o‘z bilimingizni chuqurlashtiradi.

steps.en: Offer weekly help to 3–5 younger students (IELTS, maths, application steps)
steps.uz: 3–5 kichik o‘quvchiga haftalik yordam taklif qiling (IELTS, matematika, ariza bosqichlari)

steps.en: Set a goal with each and track progress
steps.uz: Har biri bilan maqsad qo‘ying va o‘sishni kuzating

steps.en: Run one open Q&A session for a larger group
steps.uz: Kattaroq guruh uchun bitta ochiq savol-javob o‘tkazing

steps.en: Record outcomes honestly
steps.uz: Natijalarni halol yozing

cv.en: Mentor to [n] students preparing for [exam/applications]; [outcome]
cv.uz: [Imtihon/ariza]ga tayyorlanayotgan [n] o‘quvchiga murabbiy; [natija]

angle.en: Fine as a supporting point; rarely the main story.
angle.uz: Qo‘shimcha nuqta sifatida yaxshi; kamdan-kam asosiy hikoya.

pitfall.en: Claiming credit for others’ results.
pitfall.uz: Boshqalarning natijasini o‘zingizniki qilib ko‘rsatish.

evidence.en: Session notes, messages of thanks, outcomes.

ladder.en: Regular mentoring
Measured progress for mentees
A group or online community you run
ladder.uz: Siz boshqaradigan guruh yoki onlayn jamoa

title.en: Write or translate quality Wikipedia articles in Uzbek
title.uz: O‘zbek Vikipediyasida sifatli maqolalar yozing yoki tarjima qiling

what.en: Uzbek-language knowledge online is thin. Well-sourced articles in your subject are public, checkable impact.
what.uz: Internetda o‘zbek tilidagi bilim kam. Sohangizdagi manbali maqolalar — ochiq, tekshirsa bo‘ladigan hissa.

steps.en: Pick 5–10 important topics in your subject missing or weak on Uzbek Wikipedia
steps.uz: O‘zbek Vikipediyasida yo‘q yoki zaif bo‘lgan sohangizdagi 5–10 muhim mavzuni tanlang

steps.en: Translate or write them with proper references
steps.uz: Ularni to‘g‘ri manbalar bilan tarjima qiling yoki yozing

steps.en: Respond to editors’ comments
steps.uz: Muharrirlar izohlariga javob bering

steps.en: Track page views after a few months
steps.uz: Bir necha oydan keyin ko‘rishlar sonini kuzating

cv.en: Wrote/translated [n] Uzbek Wikipedia articles on [subject] (~[views] views)
cv.uz: [Soha] bo‘yicha [n] ta o‘zbekcha Vikipediya maqolasi yozildi/tarjima qilindi (~[ko‘rishlar] ko‘rish)

angle.en: Links your subject to access to knowledge in Uzbekistan.
angle.uz: Sohangizni O‘zbekistonda bilimga kirish imkoniyatiga bog‘laydi.

pitfall.en: Machine translation without checking — editors delete it, and it shows nothing.
pitfall.uz: Tekshirilmagan mashina tarjimasi — muharrirlar o‘chiradi va u hech narsa ko‘rsatmaydi.

evidence.en: Your contributions page, view statistics.

ladder.en: 5 well-sourced articles
10+ articles with sustained views
Organised others to contribute

title.en: Run a regular explainer series on your subject
title.uz: Sohangiz bo‘yicha muntazam tushuntiruvchi seriya yuriting

what.en: Short posts, videos or a blog explaining your field in Uzbek show understanding and consistency.
what.uz: Sohangizni o‘zbek tilida tushuntiruvchi qisqa post, video yoki blog tushunish va izchillikni ko‘rsatadi.

steps.en: Choose one format you can sustain weekly (post, short video, article)
steps.uz: Har hafta davom ettira oladigan bitta formatni tanlang (post, qisqa video, maqola)

steps.en: Plan 12 topics in advance, from basic to advanced
steps.uz: Oddiydan murakkabgacha 12 mavzuni oldindan rejalang

steps.en: Check facts against good sources; cite them
steps.uz: Faktlarni yaxshi manbalar bilan tekshiring; manbani ko‘rsating

steps.en: Track reach and the questions people ask
steps.uz: Qamrov va odamlar beradigan savollarni kuzating

cv.en: Created [n]-part explainer series on [topic] in Uzbek ([platform], ~[followers/views])
cv.uz: [Mavzu] bo‘yicha o‘zbek tilida [n] qismli tushuntiruvchi seriya ([platforma], ~[obunachilar/ko‘rishlar])

angle.en: Explain a concept you found hard to make simple — that is the interesting part.
angle.uz: Soddalashtirish qiyin bo‘lgan tushunchani tushuntiring — eng qiziq qism shu.

pitfall.en: Follower counts without substance; readers look at the content.
pitfall.uz: Mazmunsiz obunachilar soni; o‘quvchilar mazmunga qaraydi.

evidence.en: Links to the series, analytics screenshots.

ladder.en: 12 consistent posts
An audience that asks questions
Invited to speak or write elsewhere because of it
ladder.uz: Shu tufayli boshqa joyda gapirish yoki yozishga taklif qilingan

title.en: Help a local small business with one measurable improvement
title.uz: Mahalliy kichik biznesga bitta o‘lchanadigan yaxshilanishda yordam bering

what.en: A real client and a result is work experience you can create yourself.
what.uz: Haqiqiy mijoz va natija — o‘zingiz yarata oladigan ish tajribasi.

steps.en: Offer a local shop, workshop or family business one specific help (bookkeeping sheet, online menu, social media, stock tracking)
steps.uz: Mahalliy do‘kon, ustaxona yoki oilaviy biznesga bitta aniq yordam taklif qiling (hisob jadvali, onlayn menyu, ijtimoiy tarmoq, zaxira hisobi)

steps.en: Agree what success means (time saved, orders, errors)
steps.uz: Muvaffaqiyat nimani anglatishini kelishing (tejalgan vaqt, buyurtmalar, xatolar)

steps.en: Deliver it in 4–6 weeks
steps.uz: 4–6 haftada bajaring

steps.en: Measure the result and ask the owner for a short reference
steps.uz: Natijani o‘lchang va egasidan qisqa tavsiya so‘rang

cv.en: Built [solution] for [type of business]; [result, e.g. order errors fell from x to y]
cv.uz: [Biznes turi] uchun [yechim] yaratildi; [natija, masalan buyurtma xatolari x dan y ga kamaydi]

angle.en: What you learned about how real businesses work.
angle.uz: Haqiqiy biznes qanday ishlashi haqida nimani o‘rganganingiz.

pitfall.en: Doing it for a relative and overstating it — be honest about the setting.
pitfall.uz: Qarindosh uchun qilib, uni oshirib ko‘rsatish — vaziyatni halol ayting.

evidence.en: Before/after numbers, the owner’s note, screenshots.

ladder.en: Delivered and used
Measured result and a reference
Repeat clients or paid work

title.en: Run a tiny business experiment with honest accounts
title.uz: Halol hisob-kitob bilan kichik biznes tajribasini o‘tkazing

what.en: Selling one product or service and keeping real accounts teaches more than a business plan nobody tests.
what.uz: Bitta mahsulot yoki xizmat sotib, haqiqiy hisob yuritish — hech kim sinamagan biznes-rejadan ko‘proq o‘rgatadi.

steps.en: Pick a product/service you can start with very little money
steps.uz: Juda kam pul bilan boshlash mumkin bo‘lgan mahsulot/xizmatni tanlang

steps.en: Test demand with 10 real customers before investing more
steps.uz: Ko‘proq sarflashdan oldin 10 ta haqiqiy mijoz bilan talabni sinang

steps.en: Keep simple accounts: costs, revenue, profit, time spent
steps.uz: Oddiy hisob yuriting: xarajat, tushum, foyda, sarflangan vaqt

steps.en: Write a one-page review: what worked, what you would change
steps.uz: Bir betlik sharh yozing: nima ishladi, nimani o‘zgartirardingiz

cv.en: Ran [business] for [months]: [n] customers, revenue [x], profit [y]; [key lesson]
cv.uz: [Oylar] davomida [biznes] yuritildi: [n] mijoz, tushum [x], foyda [y]; [asosiy saboq]

angle.en: A decision you made because of the numbers.
angle.uz: Raqamlar tufayli qabul qilgan qaroringiz.

pitfall.en: Inflating revenue or calling it a “startup” without customers.
pitfall.uz: Tushumni oshirib ko‘rsatish yoki mijozsiz “startap” deyish.

evidence.en: The accounts sheet, customer feedback.

ladder.en: First paying customers with honest accounts
ladder.uz: Halol hisob bilan birinchi to‘lovchi mijozlar

ladder.en: Repeat customers and a profitable month
A small team or a registered business
ladder.uz: Kichik jamoa yoki ro‘yxatdan o‘tgan biznes

title.en: An internship with a defined task and output
title.uz: Aniq vazifa va natijali amaliyot

what.en: An internship counts when you can name what you produced. Ask for a project, not just “helping”.
what.uz: Amaliyot nima ishlab chiqarganingizni ayta olsangizgina hisoblanadi. Shunchaki “yordam” emas, loyiha so‘rang.

steps.en: Send a short CV and a specific offer to 10–15 firms, banks, NGOs or labs
steps.uz: 10–15 firma, bank, NNT yoki laboratoriyaga qisqa CV va aniq taklif yuboring

steps.en: In the first week, agree one task you will own
steps.uz: Birinchi haftada o‘zingiz javob beradigan bitta vazifani kelishing

steps.en: Keep a weekly log of what you did and its result
steps.uz: Har hafta nima qilganingiz va natijasini yozib boring

steps.en: Before leaving, ask for a reference that mentions the task
steps.uz: Ketishdan oldin vazifani eslatuvchi tavsiya so‘rang

cv.en: Intern, [organisation] ([dates]): [task]; [result with a number]
cv.uz: Amaliyotchi, [tashkilot] ([sanalar]): [vazifa]; [raqamli natija]

angle.en: One problem you solved there and what it taught you about the field.
angle.uz: U yerda hal qilgan bitta muammo va u soha haqida nimani o‘rgatgani.

pitfall.en: “Worked as an intern” with no task or result — readers skip it.
pitfall.uz: Vazifa yoki natijasiz “amaliyotchi bo‘lib ishladim” — o‘quvchilar o‘tkazib yuboradi.

evidence.en: Employer letter with dates and hours, your work samples (if allowed).
evidence.uz: Sana va soatlar ko‘rsatilgan ish beruvchi xati, ish namunalari (ruxsat bo‘lsa).

ladder.en: Completed internship with a defined task
A result with a number and a reference
Invited back or offered a job
ladder.uz: Qayta taklif qilingan yoki ishga chaqirilgan

title.en: Two years of relevant full-time work (for DAAD EPOS-type scholarships)
title.uz: Ikki yillik tegishli to‘liq stavkali ish (DAAD EPOS kabi grantlar uchun)

what.en: Some master’s scholarships for professionals require about two years of relevant work after your first degree. Plan the work so it tells a story.
what.uz: Mutaxassislar uchun ayrim magistratura grantlari birinchi darajadan keyin taxminan ikki yillik tegishli ishni talab qiladi. Ishni hikoya bo‘ladigan qilib rejalang.

steps.en: Check each scholarship’s exact work rule (EPOS: about two years after the bachelor’s)
steps.uz: Har bir grantning aniq ish qoidasini tekshiring (EPOS: bakalavrdan keyin taxminan ikki yil)

steps.en: Choose work related to the master’s you want
steps.uz: Xohlagan magistraturangizga bog‘liq ish tanlang

steps.en: Ask for responsibilities you can describe with results
steps.uz: Natija bilan tasvirlay oladigan mas’uliyatlar so‘rang

steps.en: Keep a record of projects and numbers for your CV and letter
steps.uz: CV va xat uchun loyihalar va raqamlarni yozib boring

cv.en: [Role], [organisation] ([dates]): [responsibility]; [result with a number]
cv.uz: [Lavozim], [tashkilot] ([sanalar]): [mas’uliyat]; [raqamli natija]

angle.en: Why you need this master’s to solve a problem you met at work.
angle.uz: Ishda duch kelgan muammoni hal qilish uchun nega aynan shu magistratura kerakligi.

pitfall.en: Unrelated jobs — the connection to the programme is what panels judge.
pitfall.uz: Bog‘liq bo‘lmagan ishlar — hay’at aynan dastur bilan bog‘liqlikni baholaydi.

evidence.en: Employment certificate with dates, reference letters, project summaries.
evidence.uz: Sanalar ko‘rsatilgan ish joyi ma’lumotnomasi, tavsiyanomalar, loyiha xulosalari.

ladder.en: Meets the time rule
Clear progression and results
A manager who will write a specific letter

title.en: Take part in a hackathon or case competition — and finish the product
title.uz: Hakaton yoki keys tanlovida qatnashing — va mahsulotni tugating

what.en: Short, intense team competitions show you can build or analyse under pressure. Finishing the idea afterwards shows more.
what.uz: Qisqa, jadal jamoaviy tanlovlar bosim ostida yarata yoki tahlil qila olishingizni ko‘rsatadi. Keyin g‘oyani tugatish yanada ko‘proq ko‘rsatadi.

steps.en: Join one local or online hackathon or business case competition
steps.uz: Bitta mahalliy yoki onlayn hakaton yoki biznes-keys tanloviga qo‘shiling

steps.en: Take a clear role in the team
steps.uz: Jamoada aniq rol oling

steps.en: Submit a working demo or a complete case
steps.uz: Ishlaydigan demo yoki to‘liq keys topshiring

steps.en: After the event, improve it for two more weeks and publish it
steps.uz: Tadbirdan keyin yana ikki hafta yaxshilab, e’lon qiling

cv.en: [Event] ([year]) — [role]; built [product]/solved [case]; [result]
cv.uz: [Tadbir] ([yil]) — [rol]; [mahsulot] yaratildi/[keys] yechildi; [natija]

angle.en: What you did after the event is the interesting part.
angle.uz: Tadbirdan keyin nima qilganingiz — eng qiziq qism.

pitfall.en: A long list of events with no result.
pitfall.uz: Natijasiz uzun tadbirlar ro‘yxati.

evidence.en: Demo link, slides, result announcement.

ladder.en: Submitted a complete entry
Placed or won a prize
Turned it into a product people use

title.en: Contribute to an open-source project
title.uz: Ochiq kodli loyihaga hissa qo‘shing

what.en: Merged contributions to a real project prove you can read others’ code and work to professional standards.
what.uz: Haqiqiy loyihaga qabul qilingan hissalar boshqalarning kodini o‘qiy olishingiz va professional standartda ishlashingizni isbotlaydi.

steps.en: Pick a project you use, and read its contributing guide
steps.uz: O‘zingiz ishlatadigan loyihani tanlang va hissa qo‘shish qo‘llanmasini o‘qing

steps.en: Start with documentation or “good first issue” tasks
steps.uz: Hujjatlar yoki “good first issue” vazifalaridan boshlang

steps.en: Get 2–3 pull requests reviewed and merged
steps.uz: 2–3 ta pull request ko‘rib chiqilib qabul qilinsin

steps.en: Take on a slightly larger issue
steps.uz: Biroz kattaroq vazifani oling

cv.en: Open-source contributor to [project]: [n] merged pull requests ([what they did])
cv.uz: [Loyiha]ga ochiq kod hissasi: [n] ta qabul qilingan pull request ([nima qilgani])

angle.en: Something you learned from a code review.
angle.uz: Kod tekshiruvidan o‘rgangan narsangiz.

pitfall.en: Trivial typo fixes listed as major contributions.
pitfall.uz: Arzimas imlo tuzatishlarini katta hissa deb yozish.

evidence.en: Links to merged pull requests.

ladder.en: First merged contributions
A meaningful feature or fix
A regular contributor or maintainer

title.en: Map your neighbourhood on OpenStreetMap
title.uz: Mahallangizni OpenStreetMap’ga tushiring

what.en: Adding schools, clinics, ramps or bus stops helps everyone and is a concrete, checkable contribution.
what.uz: Maktab, poliklinika, pandus yoki bekatlarni qo‘shish hammaga foyda va aniq, tekshirsa bo‘ladigan hissa.

steps.en: Learn the basics of OpenStreetMap editing
steps.uz: OpenStreetMap tahririning asoslarini o‘rganing

steps.en: Choose one theme (accessibility, schools, water points) and one area
steps.uz: Bitta mavzu (qulaylik, maktablar, suv nuqtalari) va bitta hududni tanlang

steps.en: Map it carefully with local knowledge
steps.uz: Mahalliy bilim bilan ehtiyotkorlik bilan xaritaga tushiring

steps.en: Invite 2–3 friends and run a mapping afternoon
steps.uz: 2–3 do‘stingizni taklif qilib, xaritalash kunini o‘tkazing

cv.en: Mapped [n] [features] in [area] on OpenStreetMap; organised a mapping session for [n] people
cv.uz: OpenStreetMap’da [hudud]da [n] ta [obyekt] xaritaga tushirildi; [n] kishi uchun xaritalash mashg‘uloti tashkil qilindi

angle.en: Connect it to a planning, transport or social question you care about.
angle.uz: Uni sizni qiziqtirgan rejalashtirish, transport yoki ijtimoiy savolga bog‘lang.

pitfall.en: Mass edits without checking — they get reverted.
pitfall.uz: Tekshirilmagan ommaviy tahrirlar — ular bekor qilinadi.

evidence.en: Your OpenStreetMap profile and edits.

ladder.en: Careful edits in one area
A themed dataset others can use
A group effort you organised

title.en: Start the language of your target country (German, Turkish, Korean, Hungarian, Malay)
title.uz: Maqsad davlatingiz tilini boshlang (nemis, turk, koreys, venger, malay)

what.en: Even A2–B1 helps daily life, part-time work and some scholarships (e.g. Korean for GKS life; German for German-taught bachelor’s). For German-taught degrees it is the entry requirement.
what.uz: Hatto A2–B1 ham kundalik hayot, yarim stavka ish va ayrim grantlarda yordam beradi (masalan, GKS hayoti uchun koreys tili; nemis tilidagi bakalavr uchun nemis tili). Nemis tilidagi darajalar uchun bu kirish talabi.

steps.en: Check whether your target programme is taught in the local language (see the university pages)
steps.uz: Maqsad dasturingiz mahalliy tilda o‘qitiladimi, tekshiring (universitet sahifalariga qarang)

steps.en: Choose a structured course and a recognised exam level to aim for (TestDaF/DSH, TOPIK, TÖMER…)
steps.uz: Tizimli kurs va nishonga olinadigan tan olingan imtihon darajasini tanlang (TestDaF/DSH, TOPIK, TÖMER…)

steps.en: Study 4–5 hours a week with weekly speaking practice
steps.uz: Haftalik og‘zaki mashq bilan haftasiga 4–5 soat o‘qing

steps.en: Sit the exam once mocks reach the level
steps.uz: Mocklar darajaga yetgach imtihon topshiring

cv.en: [Language]: [level], [exam] ([year])
cv.uz: [Til]: [daraja], [imtihon] ([yil])

angle.en: Shows commitment to living in the country — mention it in “why this country”.
angle.uz: Davlatda yashashga jiddiyligingizni ko‘rsatadi — “nega bu davlat”da eslating.

pitfall.en: Writing “basic” without any certificate when a programme requires a level.
pitfall.uz: Dastur daraja talab qilganda sertifikatsiz “boshlang‘ich” deb yozish.

evidence.en: Certificate, course record.

ladder.en: A1–A2 with a course record
B1–B2 certificate
The level a local-language programme requires
ladder.uz: Mahalliy tildagi dastur talab qiladigan daraja

title.en: Apply to a summer school or short programme in your field
title.uz: Sohangiz bo‘yicha yozgi maktab yoki qisqa dasturga topshiring

what.en: Many universities and foundations run short programmes, some funded. Getting in is itself a selective signal.
what.uz: Ko‘p universitet va jamg‘armalar qisqa dasturlar o‘tkazadi, ayrimlari moliyalashtiriladi. Qabul qilinishning o‘zi tanlov belgisi.

steps.en: Search university and foundation sites in your target countries for summer or winter schools 6–9 months ahead
steps.uz: 6–9 oy oldin maqsad davlatlardagi universitet va jamg‘arma saytlaridan yozgi yoki qishki maktablarni qidiring

steps.en: Check eligibility, cost and any fee waivers on the official page
steps.uz: Rasmiy sahifada muvofiqlik, narx va chegirmalarni tekshiring

steps.en: Prepare a short motivation letter and CV
steps.uz: Qisqa motivatsion xat va CV tayyorlang

steps.en: If admitted, produce something there (a project, a presentation)
steps.uz: Qabul qilinsangiz, u yerda nimadir yarating (loyiha, taqdimot)

cv.en: [Programme], [institution] ([dates]) — [selective/funded if stated]; [project]
cv.uz: [Dastur], [muassasa] ([sanalar]) — [ko‘rsatilgan bo‘lsa tanlovli/moliyalashtirilgan]; [loyiha]

angle.en: What you learned about studying in that country and that subject.
angle.uz: O‘sha davlat va sohada o‘qish haqida nimani o‘rganganingiz.

pitfall.en: Paying for “prestige” programmes that admit everyone — check selectivity honestly.
pitfall.uz: Hammani qabul qiladigan “nufuzli” dasturlarga pul to‘lash — tanlovni halol tekshiring.

evidence.en: Acceptance letter, certificate, the project.

ladder.en: Attended and completed
Admitted to a selective or funded programme
ladder.uz: Tanlovli yoki moliyalashtirilgan dasturga qabul qilingan

ladder.en: Produced work there that a lecturer noticed
ladder.uz: U yerda o‘qituvchi e’tibor bergan ish yaratgan

title.en: Put your best work in one simple portfolio page
title.uz: Eng yaxshi ishlaringizni bitta oddiy portfolio sahifasiga joylang

what.en: One link where a reader can see your projects, writing and certificates — useful in CVs and interviews.
what.uz: O‘quvchi loyihalar, yozuvlar va sertifikatlarni ko‘ra oladigan bitta havola — CV va suhbatda foydali.

steps.en: Choose your 3–5 strongest pieces of evidence
steps.uz: 3–5 ta eng kuchli dalilingizni tanlang

steps.en: Write two lines for each: what it is and your role
steps.uz: Har biri uchun ikki qator yozing: bu nima va sizning rolingiz

steps.en: Publish as a simple page (a free site builder or GitHub Pages)
steps.uz: Oddiy sahifa sifatida e’lon qiling (bepul sayt konstruktori yoki GitHub Pages)

steps.en: Put the link in your CV header
steps.uz: Havolani CV sarlavhasiga qo‘ying

cv.en: Portfolio: [link]
cv.uz: Portfolio: [havola]

pitfall.en: Including weak or unfinished work; less is more.
pitfall.uz: Zaif yoki tugallanmagan ishlarni qo‘shish; kamroq — yaxshiroq.

evidence.en: The page itself.

ladder.en: A clean page with 3 pieces
5 pieces with clear roles
Pieces that link to outside proof (published work, repositories)
ladder.uz: Tashqi dalilga havola qiluvchi ishlar (nashrlar, repozitoriylar)
